description: The plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores for two different tokenization training methods, MATTER and w/o material information, across varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 0.6 to 1.3, and the y-axis indicates the Macro-F1 Score, ranging from 48% to 58%. The MATTER method, represented by the pink line, starts at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score, peaks at 58% near x=1.0, and ends at 50% near x=1.3, showing a consistent decline after its peak. The w/o material information method, represented by the purple line, begins at 52.5%, peaks at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range. The shaded areas indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2. The results suggest that MATTER consistently outperforms the alternative across all token counts, with a sharper decline in performance at higher token counts for both conditions.
